top_catalysts.event: Williams缓和加息时间压力，但没有承诺宽松
top_catalysts.what_happened: Williams said there was no urgency for another policy action after September, while his forecast still allowed one further increase late in the year.
top_catalysts.what_changed: The communication left room to wait for more evidence instead of assuming an immediate consecutive hike.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: The timing of policy moves can affect front-end rates independently of long-maturity inflation compensation and sovereign supply concerns.
top_catalysts.transmission: The timing of policy moves can affect front-end rates independently of long-maturity inflation compensation and sovereign supply concerns.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Subsequent officials and data support waiting without signs of broader inflation persistence.
top_catalysts.invalidation: A renewed inflation shock requires faster action and undermines the gradual timing interpretation.

top_catalysts.event: CarMax销量恢复伴随单车毛利压力
top_catalysts.what_happened: CarMax reported $7.9 billion of quarterly revenue, up 19.5%, while retail used-car units rose 13.8% and gross profit per unit fell $111 to $2,105.
top_catalysts.what_changed: Volume recovery and weaker unit margins moved in opposite directions, requiring a more nuanced demand assessment.
top_catalysts.why_it_matters: Sales volumes, pricing and financing determine total profit; operating leverage should not be inferred from revenue growth alone.
top_catalysts.transmission: Sales volumes, pricing and financing determine total profit; operating leverage should not be inferred from revenue growth alone.
top_catalysts.confirmation: Stronger volumes continue to support total gross profit and cash generation despite lower profit per vehicle.
top_catalysts.invalidation: Price concessions or credit losses erode the economic benefit from increased sales volume.
